corrective_change.description: The apparatus now resolves the supplied execution-basis commit and requires it to equal current committed HEAD before any model call.

finding: The single inference ran from the committed apparatus at actual_commit, but the caller supplied a mistyped non-resolving full SHA as descriptive execution-basis metadata. The original mechanical evaluator did not verify that coordinate and therefore reported PASS with an incomplete check set.

mechanical_evaluation.reassessment_basis: All retained mechanical checks passed; actual execution basis is recovered explicitly; the raw request and response are unchanged; the new pre-call gate prevents recurrence.

path_portability_correction.finding: The original mechanical artifact retained workstation-absolute path strings. The referenced artifact hashes and these repository-relative paths preserve portable lookup; future evaluations emit the frozen repository-relative paths.
